## Summary

Describe the notebook, analysis, frontend, or documentation change.

## Data and privacy

- [ ] Source terms and permitted access were reviewed
- [ ] No credentials, cookies, or personal data are committed
- [ ] New data fields and provenance are documented
- [ ] Notebook output is reproducible or intentionally omitted

## Validation

- [ ] Notebook cells were tested with a permitted sample
- [ ] Frontend was checked through a local static server
- [ ] HTML/CSS paths and accessibility were reviewed
